title: Can LLMs Rank the Harmfulness of Smaller LLMs? We are Not There Yet

bias_targets.methodology: Eliciting responses using harm-triggering prompts mined from the HH-RLHF dataset, then using human annotators and large LLM judges to comparatively rank the smaller models' outputs on a 0-3 harmfulness scale. The evaluation criteria explicitly include checking for discriminatory or biased language against groups based on race, gender, religion, nationality, and sexual orientation.
